title: Non-Semisimple Integrability and Dynamical Limits
summary: We investigate Jordan structure and dynamical limits in six families of integrable spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ chains obtained from the boost automorphism method. Local operator algebras connect nilpotent evolution on finite periodic chains to central defects in spectral additivity, polynomial unipotent $R$-matrices and constant braid limits. For conservative endpoint erosion, we determine the characteristic and minimal polynomials and show that the Jordan partition can change while both polynomials remain unchanged.
